claim: Hovering a separator leaves a pending submenu open running, where hovering a panel's padding cancels it
An oversized RTL menu with its anchor past the right edge is placed left of the bounds (e.g. x=-50) instead of clamped to the left bound

triage.scenario: Bounds x=0 width=100, anchor x=200, menu width 150: returns -50
triage.cause: reverse helper missing left-bound clamp the forward helper has

claim: A throwing setter leaves the rejected value cached as held, and a same-value retry is suppressed by the equality check

triage.scenario: A text, number or color row's setter throws before applying the value; the menu later reads the rejected value, and retrying the same value never reaches the setter
